title: Summary
summary: Exercise and nutrition over a day or a run of days.
description: The Summary tab answers whether the training and the eating are on track over more than one day.

stories.want: to see my cardio minutes against a weekly target
stories.soThat: I know whether I need another session before the week ends

requirements.text: The Summary's period is chosen from `summary.periods`, defaulting to Last 7 days, with navigation between dates.
The 7-day cardio target is `cardio.weekly-target` and can be changed; the 24-day target is four times the 7-day one.
A workout counts its full duration as cardio when its average heart rate is above `cardio.min-avg-hr`; at exactly that value, or with no average, it does not.
A workout's Cardio switch overrides the automatic rule, including after edits and re-syncs, until the user chooses to use the automatic rule again.
Zone 2 minutes are tracked separately from cardio minutes.
Over a multi-day period, nutrition is shown as per-day averages.
Energy and macros are always visible; keto, micronutrients, source filters and other compounds are under Nutrition details.
